info.name: Simple Express API
info.description: Generated from the OpenAPI document by npm run postman. Log in first, as tokens and created ids are saved to collection variables.

item.name: Log in and start a session

request.description: With client `web`, the refresh token is set as an httpOnly cookie. With client `native`, it is returned in the body.
Native clients send the refresh token in the body. Web clients send an empty request with the cookie. Each refresh token works once, so store the new one.
The current session stays active, and all others are revoked.

Always returns 202, whether or not the email has an account. The link opens `PASSWORD_RESET_URL` with `#token=...`, and expires in 30 minutes. Only the newest link works, and each account gets at most three an hour.

item.name: Set a new password with a reset token

request.description: The token works once. All of the user’s sessions are revoked.

item.name: End all sessions for the current user
List all blogs, including drafts (needs blogs.manage)
Get any blog, including drafts (needs blogs.manage)
List the banners the storefront shows

request.description: Returns active banners whose dates include now, in position order. Show mobileImageUrl on phones when it is set, and imageUrl otherwise.
Upload the images through /api/assets first, then send their ids. A store can have at most 15 banners, counting inactive ones.

body.raw:
{
  "assetId": "{{assetId}}",
  "altText": "Holiday sale, up to 30% off",
  "title": "Holiday Sale",
  "subtitle": "Up to 30% off",
  "linkUrl": "/categories"
}

item.name: List every banner, including inactive and scheduled ones (needs banners.manage)

request.description: meta.maxBanners is the most a store can have, counting inactive ones, so the admin app can warn before the limit.
Set mobileAssetId to null to use the default image on phones.
Its images stay in /api/assets.
Categories can be up to 3 levels deep. Names must be unique among categories with the same parent.

item.name: Get every category, nested under its parent
Update or move a category (needs categories.manage)

request.description: A new `parentId` moves the category with everything below it, and `null` makes it top-level. A move into its own subtree, or deeper than the limit, returns 400.
Fails with 409 while the category has subcategories, or any product, active or not, uses it.
Returns active products that have at least one active variant.

item.name: Create a product and its variants (needs products.manage)
List all products, including inactive ones (needs products.view)
Get any product, including inactive ones and their variants (needs products.view)

request.description: Existing options can be renamed, but options cannot be added.
The product is kept, and can be restored by setting `active` to true.

item.name: Add an uploaded asset to a product (needs products.manage)

request.description: A product can have up to 10 images.

item.name: Change the alt text or position of an image (needs products.manage)
Remove an image from a product (needs products.manage)

request.description: The uploaded file is kept. Fails with 409 while a variant uses the image.

item.name: Update a variant (needs products.manage or, for stock only, inventory.manage)

request.description: Prices are read from the variants each time, and are never stored.

item.name: Price a guest cart without saving it

request.description: Variants that no longer exist are left out of the response.

item.name: Move a guest cart into the current user’s cart

request.description: An item in both carts keeps the higher quantity, so a retried request changes nothing. Quantities are reduced to the available stock, and unavailable variants are skipped. Both are listed in `adjustments`.

item.name: Add a variant to the cart

request.description: If the variant is already in the cart, the quantities are added together.

item.name: Set the quantity of an item
List the payment methods customers can choose

request.description: Returns enabled methods only. Account details are shown on the order after checkout. COD is always available to logged-in customers, and is not listed.
Upload a QR image through /api/assets first, then send its id as qrAssetId.

item.name: List all payment methods with account details (needs payment_methods.manage)

request.description: Orders already placed keep the details they were given.
Fails with 409 once orders use it. Set enabled to false instead.

item.name: Price items with shipping and tax

request.description: Shows the final total before checkout. Send the returned `totalCents` to checkout as `expectedTotalCents`.

item.name: List the current user’s orders, newest first

request.description: Reduces stock, saves the order, and empties the cart in one transaction. Repeating a request with the same `idempotencyKey` returns the original order with 200. Fails with 409 if the cart is empty, an item is unavailable or short of stock, or the total differs from `expectedTotalCents`.

Guests cannot use COD, and an order can have up to 10 items. Keep the returned `guestToken`, as it is the only way back to the order. Repeating a request with the same email and `idempotencyKey` returns the original order with 200.

item.name: Submit a payment reference for a guest order
Move an order to its next status (needs orders.manage)

request.description: Allowed moves: pending to confirmed or cancelled, confirmed to shipped or cancelled, and shipped to delivered or returned. Cancelling returns stock. Returning does not, as the item may be damaged. Delivering a COD order marks it paid.
Marks the order paid and moves it to pending.
Cancels the order and returns its stock.
Records a refund made outside the system. The order must be cancelled, returned, or delivered.

item.name: Get one of the current user’s orders

request.description: Used after paying a manual method. An admin then checks it.

item.name: Cancel a pending or unpaid order

request.description: Returns the stock. Fails with 409 once the order has been confirmed.

item.name: List the current user’s addresses, default first

request.description: A user’s first address becomes the default. A user can save up to 20.

item.name: List uploaded files, newest first (needs assets.manage)

request.description: Accepts one JPEG, PNG, or WebP image of up to 5 MB. Attach it to a product or blog using the returned id.
Fails with 409 while a product or blog uses the asset.

item.name: Get sales totals for a date range (needs reports.sales)

request.description: Days follow Manila time, and both dates are included. Without dates, it covers the last 30 days. Totals use the amounts saved on each order, so changing the tax rate never changes past figures.

item.name: Get sales per day, week, or month, for a chart (needs reports.sales)

request.description: Returns a point for every period, including empty ones. Weeks start on Monday, and each point is dated by the first day of its period. A daily report can cover up to 366 days.
Counts orders placed in the range, apart from cancelled ones. Variants are combined into their product, and inactive products are included.

item.name: Count orders by status, and what needs doing (needs reports.operations)

request.description: Shows every order as it is now, with no date range.

item.name: List variants that are running out (needs reports.operations)

request.description: Only variants on sale are listed, lowest stock first.

item.name: List changes made by admins and to accounts, newest first (needs audit_logs.view)

request.description: Records admin changes to products, variants, images, categories, blogs, payment methods, files, and orders, and changes to passwords, sessions, and roles. Entries cannot be edited or deleted. Dates follow Manila time, and both are included.

item.name: List every permission, for the role editor (super admin)
Rename a role or change its permissions (super admin)

request.description: Sending `permissions` replaces the whole list. Users with the role get the new permissions on their next request. The Super admin role cannot be changed.

item.name: Delete a role that no user has (super admin)
Find users to give a role, newest first (super admin)

request.description: Send `roleId: null` to make the user a customer. Super admins cannot change their own role, so the store always keeps one. The change applies on the next request.
